name: cinvar-project-inspector
description: Inspect a local Cinvar project and check it before export. Read-only.
long_description: Pick a Cinvar project folder and ask Claude to summarize it, check it for structural problems (missing media, overlaps, empty timelines) or tell you what would stop it exporting on this machine. Three read-only tools. It cannot edit, render, generate or export anything, and it does not use the network.

tools.name: cinvar.project.status
tools.description: Summarize the project: assets, timelines, tracks, captions, issues.

tools.name: cinvar.qa.project_check
tools.description: Check for missing media, overlaps, empty timelines, zero-length clips.

tools.name: cinvar.render.preflight
tools.description: Check whether an export is feasible on this machine, without rendering.

project_dir.title: Cinvar project folder
project_dir.description: The folder containing project.json. The extension only ever looks inside this folder.
